summary: The mobile layout generally follows the monochrome theme, but contains minor contrast and alignment flaws in the file tree selection indicator and minimap metadata.

issues.title: Active state indicator boundary collision
issues.description: The active selection bar for selected rows extends flush to the outer container border rather than respecting item padding.
issues.evidence: The solid black bar beside report-draft.md touches the card's left boundary abruptly.
issues.suggestion: Inset the active indicator bar to align with row padding.

issues.title: Low contrast metadata text
issues.description: Helper labels adjacent to the minimap do not meet adequate contrast standards against the light background.
issues.evidence: The 'viewport 56×40%' and 'drag to navigate' labels appear in low-contrast light gray.
issues.suggestion: Increase text darkness token to meet minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
